title: Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - September 28, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch is live! Read on for more information.

NOTE: Orange text indicates a change between PTR and Live notes.

Hotfix - 10/5/2026

• Xal'atath Balance Updates Abilities

• Shadow Mark (Q) Void Orb speed slightly increased.

• Void Step (E) Targeting range reduced from 5 to 2.

• Distance between teleport points reduced from 7 to 6.5.

• Now prevented and interrupted by Immobilize.

• Void Volley (D) Base damage per missile reduced from 90 to 72.

• Now generates 1 charge for every Basic Attack against enemy Heroes and every 2 Basic Attacks against non-Heroes.

• Void Eruption (R) Uncharged damage reduced by 20%.

• Fully charged damage reduced by 5%.

• Talents

• Level 1 Anchored Core Radius bonus reduced from 50% to 25%.

• Level 4 Dark Barrier Now only triggers when enemy Heroes are hit

• Level 7 Silence of the Lamb Silence duration increased from 1 to 1.5 seconds.

• Level 13 Dark Heart's Protection Detonating the Dark Heart on a target affected by Shadow Mark now Silences all enemies hit. Previously silenced on cast.

• Level 20 Rift Invasion Portals now have non-lethal Health decay, stopping at 4 Health.

• Xal'atath Bug Fixes

• General Orbiting orbs now pause during Time Stop and resume afterward.

• Fixed issues that prevented orbiting orbs from correctly following the missile or continuing to orbit after a release queued during Time Stop.

• Fixed an issue where Xal'atath was appearing brighter than intended in the game.

• Void Volley (D) Fixed an issue that caused impact visual effects to appear at the cursor location instead of where missiles hit.

• Fixed an issue that prevented the charge indicator from immediately displaying 1 charge upon reaching the second milestone.

• Void Eruption (R) Can now be queued to cast or release during Time Stop.

• Casting during Time Stop immediately enters targeting, with charging beginning when Time Stop ends.

• Releasing during Time Stop queues the release for when Time Stop ends. The Ability button becomes greyed out while a release is queued.

• Issuing another Ability, movement, or attack order during Time Stop cancels the pending cast or queued release.

• Casting Void Eruption again during Time Stop clears earlier queued orders.

• Fixed issues that could allow an additional charge to begin while already charging or during Void Step.

• Orb growth and the flight damage timer now pause while Xal’atath is affected by Time Stop.

• General Bug Fixes ​ Fixed an issue where certain Maskless skins were not appearing in the game.

Hotfix - 9/29/2026

• Fixed an issue where some players who bought the pre-purchase bundle didn't receive Xal'atath.

• Fixed an exploit with Xal'atath's ultimate.

• Fixed an issue where Level 20 Void Convergence portal would lose life.

• Adjusted colors on Dark Heart to make visibility clearer for enemies.

Quick Navigation:

• New Hero

• Collection

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

New Hero: Xal'atath

Xal'atath has arrived in the Nexus!

Base

• Shadow Mark [Q] Shoot a single Void Orb that deals 75 damage to enemies hit, and an additional 150 damage to enemies in the center.

• If an enemy Hero or Structure is hit by the center, they are marked for 4 seconds.

• Targets afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.

• Dark Heart Ritual [W] Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50 damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.

• The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.

• The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonates on impact, dealing 305 damage to nearby enemies and an additional 150 more damage to the Marked target.

• Void Step [E] Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.

• Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage while the Ability is active.

• Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at the current location.

• Weapon Bonus Damage caps at +30%.

• Void Volley [Trait] After attacking enemies with her Basic Attacks 5 times, Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 90 damage on impact.

• Charge fully decays if Xal'atath does not hit an enemy with a Basic Attack after 6 seconds.

• Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit increases Void Volley damage by 1%. Lose all stacks upon dying. Reward (20 Stacks): Increase Void Volley's range by 2. Upon death, Xal'atath now only loses 6 stacks, but cannot fall below her current milestone minimum

• Reward (60 Stacks): Void Volley requires 1 fewer Basic Attack to charge Void Volley.

• Mythic Reward (100 Stacks): Increase Basic Attack and Void Volley damage by 50%. Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.

• Stack loss will never cause the Hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.

Talents

• Level 1 Void Adept Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

• Each successful detonation permanently increases Shadow Mark and the Dark Heart Ritual Detonation damage by 25, up to 20 times

• Anchored Core Increase Dark Heart's area by 50% and duration by 25%.

• Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 damage.

• Cloak of Shadows Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

• Level 4 Cold Feet Increase Shadow Mark's duration by 1 second.

• Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.

• Dark Barrier Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

• Void Acolyte Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.

• The next Void Volley deals 50% increased damage and costs no Mana.

• Level 7 Toxic Mark Increase Shadow Mark's duration by 1 second.

• Heroes afflicted with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 15 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.

• Silence of the Lamb Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 250 damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

• Void Summoner Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xalatath's original position. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

• Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.

• Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 95 damage per hit. Void Minions lose Health over 15 seconds.

• Level 10 Void Eruption [R] Channel a single powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.

• Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take up to 112 damage and are Blinded for 1 second.

• When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 damage.

• Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 and its explosion damage up to 700.

• Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

• Void Convergence [R] After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.

• You can have up to 1 active Void Portal.

• Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.

• Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.

• Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

• The Portal expires after 12 seconds.

• Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 56 damage per hit.

• Void Minion loses Health over 12 seconds.

• Level 13 Pull of the Dark Heart Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

• Dark Heart's Protection Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.

• Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside Dark Heart's radius.

• Crushing Cascade Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

• Level 16 Marked Resilience Basic Attacks against enemy targets afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 180 point Shield that rapidly decays.

• Relentless Whispers While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by 150%.

• Fractured Reality Increase Void Volley projectile damage by 25%.

• Void Volley projectiles leave a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 damage to enemies.

• Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flame.

• Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds.

• Damage increases up to 300%.

• Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

• Level 20 Harbinger's Consumption Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

• Rift Invasion Void Convergence's Void Portal no longer has a life duration, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

• Dueling Orbs Gain 1 additional Shadow Mark charge.

• Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.

• Unstable Core When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on an enemy Hero afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds.

• Enemies in the flames take 45 damage over time.

• The flames deal damage every 1 second.

• Paradox Loop After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.

Collection

• New Bundle: Dark Twilight Xal'atath Bundle Xal'atath Hero

• Twilight Xal'atath Skin

• Sin'dorei Phoenix Mount

General

• Updated Homescreen and Startup Music.

• Added the ability to ping your Healing Fountain cooldown.

Map Updates

• Garden of Terror Shambler Health and damage now begin 25% below their previous values and gradually return to their previous values over the course of the match.

Balance Update

Heroes

Abathur

Talents

• Level 13 Bombard Strain Health decay reduction lowered from 50% to 40%.

• Level 16 Survival Instincts Now provides 50% damage reduction against non-Heroes, instead of +100% Health.

Alexstrasza

Base

• Health increased from 1698 to 1780.

Talents

• Level 1 Flames of Fury Mythic Reward requirement reduced from 40 extra hits without dying to 30.

• Level 16 Overprotective Shield reduced from 70% of healing to 50%.

Garrosh

Talents

• Level 1 Unrivaled Strength Damage bonus reduced from 125% to 75%.

• Level 4 In For The Kill Damage bonus increased from 70% to 100%.

• Level 7 Oppressor Spell Power reduction decreased from 30% to 25%.

• Level 13 Bloodcraze Heal duration increased from 3 seconds to 4 seconds. Total healing remains the same.

• Double Up Armor duration increased from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.

Mal'Ganis

Base

• Night Rush [E] Cast time reduced from 0.75 seconds to 0.625 seconds.

• Vampiric Touch [D] Healing based on damage against Heroes increased from 45% to 50%.

• Healing based on damage against non-Heroes increased from 10% to 15%.

Qhira

Base

• Blood Rage [W] Damage bonus per stack decreased from 0.25% to 0.2%.

• Blood Rage base damage per tick lowered from 8 to 7.

Talents

• Level 1 Fatal Wounds Damage bonus against low Health targets increased from 50% to 70%.

• Level 13 Pulsing Pain Damage increased from 135 to 150.

• Level 16 Lingering Ailment Armor reduction decreased from -35 to -25.

Whitemane

Base

• Desperate Plea [Q] Base mana cost increased from 40 to 45. Mana scaling with each use is unchanged.

Talents

• Level 7 Intercession Cooldown increased from 60 to 75 seconds.

• Level 16 Radiance Healing increased from 175 to 190.

Yrel

Base

• Vindication [Q] Mana cost increased from 50 to 65.

Talents

• Level 13 Aldor Peacekeeper Damage reduction increased from 40% to 50%.

• Damage reduction duration increased from 3 seconds to 4 seconds.

• Velen's Chosen Damage bonus per stack decreased from 10% to 8%.

• Stacks increased from 3 to 4.

• Level 20 Seraphim Cooldown increased from 20 to 30 seconds.

Bug Fixes

Maps

• Volskaya Foundry Fixed an issue where the fort walls on one side had more Health than the other. The game is now balanced...

Heroes

• Anduin Fixed an issue that caused Leap of Faith to be delayed when cast on Rooted Heroes.

• Malfurion Fixed an issue where Entangling Roots would not continuously root enemies within its area.

• Fixed an issue that prevented Entangling Roots from applying on first contact.

• Ragnaros Fixed an issue that caused Heroic Difficulty granted 25% more damage and duration.

• Cooldown on Molten Core when Heroic Difficulty is selected decreased from 90 seconds to 70 seconds.

• Xul Fixed an issue where Xul's skeletons were sometimes not dealing damage.

title: Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - July 20, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch is live! Read on for more information.

NOTE: Orange text indicates a change between PTR and Live notes.

Quick Navigation:

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

General

• New Skin: Ruby Chromesthesia Lucio

• Haunted Mines has been added to Ranked.

• Players can now party with unplaced players in Storm League.

• Updated Homescreen and Startup Music.

Map Updates

• Hanamura Temple Additional brush has been added in several locations.

• Warhead Junction Warhead's channel penalty on interrupt reduced from 10 to 5 seconds.

Balance Update

Heroes

Abathur

Base

• Locust Strain [D] Health reduced from 350 to 225.

• Locusts no longer have a duration but now lose Health over time.

• Locusts now heal for 20% of the damage they deal, and heal for 20% of their maximum Health when a nearby Minion dies.

• Locust damage reduced from 58 to 36.

• Locusts now deal 100% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

• Locusts no longer deal 25% bonus damage to Structures.

Talents

• Level 1 Envenomed Nests Armor reduction increased from 10 to 15.

• Locust Brood Moved from Level 16 to Level 1.

• Cooldown increased from 45 to 75 seconds.

• Level 4 (New) Slapathur Abathur's Basic Attacks now deal 500% 350% bonus damage, Stun non-Heroes for 3 seconds Stun enemies, and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds . This effect has a 6 second cooldown per target against Structures and Heroes.

• Level 10 Evolve Monstrosity Now displays as a Quest.

• Abathur now has a Monstrosity unit frame for tracking Health and stacks of the unit.

• Level 16 Survival Intincts Moved from Level 1 to Level 16.

Alexstrasza

Base

• Dragonqueen [D] Cooldown now starts after Dragonqueen has expired.

• Cooldown reduced from 150 to 130 seconds.

• Talents that affect Gift of Life also apply to Breath of Life.

• Talents that affect Abundance also apply to Preservation.

• Breath of Life [Dragonqueen Q] Healing reduced from 20% to 15%.

• Preservation [Dragonqueen W] Healing reduced from 30% to 25%.

Talents

• Level 1 Live and Let Live Now also provides 25% recharge rate for Breath of Life.

• Flames of Fury Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 6 seconds.

• NEW MYTHIC REWARD: Hit an additional 40 Heroes without dying to cause Dragonqueen's duration to be refreshed when damaging an enemy Hero.

• Level 7 Lifeblossom Now makes Breath of Life remove Slows and Roots.

• Transforming into Dragonqueen will no longer remove the collected Lifeblossom.

• Level 16 Draconic Dicipline No longer affects Dragonqueen's duration.

• For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen's Basic Attacks, reduce the cooldown of Preservation by 1.25 seconds.

• Level 20 On Ruby Wings NEW FUNCTIONALITY: If at least 3 Heroes are in an area hit by a Fireball, that Fireball charge is not consumed.

• Ancient Flame ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONALITY: Now also provides +25% Health.

• Does not provide Quest stacks while active.

Blaze

Talents

• Level 1 Adrenaline Stimpack Active Attack Speed bonus reduced from 100% to 85%.

• Level 10 Bunker Drop Cooldown increased from 80 to 85 seconds.

Cho

Talents

• Level 1 Consuming Fire Healing bonus increased from 150% to a flat 75 Health.

• Calloused Hide Health threshold required to trigger reduced from 60% to 40% 50%.

• Level 7 Firestarter Cooldown reduction per Basic Attack increased from 1 to 1.5 seconds.

Gall

Talents

• Level 4 Rising Dread Bonus per bounce reduced from 25% to 20%.

• Bomb's Away No longer has a cap on stacks.

• Damage bonus per stack lowered from 5 to 4.

• Level 7 Double Trouble Shadowflame's cooldown reduction from Quest Reward increased from 0.5 to 1 second.

• Level 16 Leaden Orb Stun duration reduced from 0.75 seconds to 0.6 seconds.

Chromie

Base

• Dragon's Breath [W] Now shows a radius preview to enemies.

• Time Trap [E] Health reduced from 400 to 250.

Talents

• Level 1 Once Again The First Time Quest requirement reduced from 40 to 20 stacks.

• Quest must now be completed without dying.

• Deep Breathing Damage per stack reduced from 1% to 0.5%.

• No longer has a cap on stacks.

• Level 2 Chronic Conditions Now also causes Time Trap to activate automatically upon touching an enemy Hero.

• Slow reduced from 30% to 20%.

• Movement Speed bonus reduced from 30% to 20%.

• Level 11 Here and There Range increased from 20 to 40.

• Snap targetting is now used. The Echo nearest the player's target position will be used.

Diablo

Base

• Shadow Charge [Q] Damage increased from 40 to 45.

• Terrain collision damage increased from 130 to 140.

• Fire Stomp [W] Damage reduced from 12 to 11.

• Return damage reduced from 36 to 34.

• Overpower [E] Damage increased from 73 to 80.

Talents

• Level 7 Diabolical Momentum Cooldown reduction per Basic Attack increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds.

• Level 20 Dying Breath Cooldown reduction per Hero hit increased from 25 to 30 seconds.

• Lord of Terror Health stolen increased from 10% to 12% maximum Health.

Genji

Talents

• Level 1 Swift as the Wind Movement Speed bonus increased from 30% to 40%.

• Pathfinder Movement Speed duration increased from 4 to 6 seconds.

• Level 4 Strike at the Heart Damage increased from 134 to 142.

• Level 7 Perfect Defense Cooldown reduction per hit increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds.

• Level 13 Flow Like Water Cooldown reduction per hit increased from 3 to 4 seconds.

• Level 16 Final Cut Damage reduced from 125 to 115.

Hogger

Talents

• Level 1 On the Prowl Rage generated on activation reduced from 30 to 25.

• Level 4 Hogger's Joggers Rage threshold required to gain 10% movement speed increased from 30 to 35.

Johanna

Base

• Shield Glare [E] Cooldown increased from 12 to 13 seconds.

Talents

• Level 10 Blessed Shield Cooldown increased from 60 to 65 seconds.

Mal'Ganis

Talents

• Level 1 Will of Tichondrius Stun's duration increase reduced from 0.5 to 0.25 seconds.

• Level 16 Blind as a Bat There is now a 0.2 second reactivation delay upon finishing 3 swipes of Fel Claws. This matches the time between other swipes.

Qhira

Base

• Blood Rage [W] NEW BASELINE QUEST: Deal damage to enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed to permanently increase its damage by 0.25% per stack.

• Blood Rage's bleed damage reduced from 11 to 8.

• Revolving Sweep [E] Once attached, Revolving Sweep can no longer be detached by the target becoming Unstoppable.

Talents

• Level 1 Fatal Wounds Damage bonus against low Health targets increased from 30% to 50%.

• Quest removed.

Ragnaros

Base

• Blast Wave [E] Damage increased from 104 to 120.

• Molten Core [D] Cooldown increased from 120 to 180 seconds.

• Health increased from 3996 to 5000.

• Duration increased from 18 to 23 seconds.

• Ragnaros is now Stunned for 1 second upon exiting.

• Molten Core's Abilities range reduced from 35 to 20, but now grows from 20 to 35 over 9 seconds. Molten Swing is not affected by this.

• Molten Swing [Molten Core Q] Damage increased from 161 to 250.

• No longer deals increased damage to Minions.

• Cooldown increased from 6 seconds to 9 seconds.

• Now also knocks enemies back.

• Meteor Shower [Molten Core W] Damage increased from 151 to 200.

• Cooldown increased from 2.5 to 6 seconds.

• Area of effect increased by 66%.

• Delay between hits significantly increased.

• No longer deals increased damage to Minions.

• Slow increased from 25% to 35%.

• Now deals 75% reduced damage to Structures.

• Explosive Rune [Molten Core E] Cooldown decreased from 4 to 2.5 seconds.

• Damage adjusted from 285 on impact to 440 damage over 5 seconds.

• No longer deals increased damage to Minions.

• Now deals 75% reduced damage to Structures.

Talents

• Level 1 Engulfing Flame Damage bonus reduced from 75% to 50%.

• Level 10 Sulfuras Smash NEW MYTHIC QUEST: Hit 8 enemy Heroes with the center of Sulfuras Smash. Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an extra charge.

• Level 20 Lava Surge No longer reduces the cooldown of Lava Wave by 30 seconds.

• Now also gives +200% Movement Speed to allied Minions and Mercenaries in its path.

• Heroic Difficulty NEW FUNCTIONALITY: When Molten Core is used on a dead Fort or Keep, the cooldown reduced by 110 seconds. Passive: Increase the starting and maximum range of Molten Core's Abilities by 100%. Molten Swing is not affected by this.

Thrall

Talents

• Level 1 Crash Lightning Talent disabled in ARAM.

Whitemane

Base

• Searing Lash [E] NEW QUEST: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash to increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2.

Talents

• Level 1 Pity the Frail Cooldown reduction per hit reduced from 1.5 to 1 second.

• Inquisitor's Prayer NEW FUNCTIONALITY: For each Hero hit by Searing Lash, restore 25 Mana. Passive: Zeal's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

• Level 7 Intercession Cooldown increased 45 to 60 seconds.

• Level 13 Scarlet Wrath Mana restore increased from 0.5% to 1%.

• Level 20 Guiding Light Now also increases the Spell Power gained from Zeal's activation by 15%.

Yrel

Base

• Vindication [Q] Heal increased from 320 to 370.

• Damage increased from 140 to 160.

• Mana cost reduced from 65 to 50.

• Righteous Hammer [W] Stun duration increased from 0.75 to 1 second.

• Damage increased from 125 to 140.

• Mana cost reduced from 65 to 50.

• Avenging Wrath [E] Slow increased from 50% to 60%.

• Damage increased from 225 to 260.

• Mana cost reduced from 65 to 50.

• Divine Purpose [D] Cooldown increased to from 8 to 16 12 seconds.

• Cooldown is now reduced by 8 3 seconds whenever Yrel's Basic Abilities are interrupted.

• Cooldown is no longer reset when Yrel's Heroic Abilities are used.

Talents

• Level 4 Hand of Freedom Cooldown increased from 30 to 40 seconds.

• Movement Speed bonus reduced from 30% to 25%.

• Level 20 Seraphim Cooldown increased from 10 to 20 seconds.

Bug Fixes

General

• Attack beams from Forts, Keeps, and the Core will now be more visible when attacking Heroes.

Maps

• Haunted Mines Fixed an issue where the player would not auto-mount when using the Hearthstone from inside the mines.

• Warhead Junction Fixed an issue that caused Heroes to not be revealed while launching a Warhead.

• Fixed an issue that caused the Warhead's channel beam to persist when interrupted.

Heroes

• Ana Level 10 Eye of Horus No longer reveals in a global line when hitting a Structure.

• Removed a minor delay when dealing damage to enemy Heroes.

• Anub'arak Base Scarab Host [Trait] Fixed an issue that caused Beetles created by Ultimate Evolution clones of Anub'arak to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Fixed an issue that caused Anub'arak's Beetles to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Level 7 Leeching Scarabs Fixed an issue that caused the healing done by Leeching Scarabs to not be affected by damage modifiers.

• Arthas Base Howling Blast [W] Fixed an issue where the visuals of Howling Blast didn't match the area hit.

• Frostmourne Hungers [D] Fixed an issue where the Slow benefit of Froststrike was provided baseline.

• Level 10 Army of the Dead Fixed an issue that caused Arthas's Ghouls to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Deathwing Base Cataclysm [R] Deathwing will no longer be teleported to where Cataclysm is targeted if he is killed during Cataclysm.

• Deckard Level 10 Lorenado Fixed an issue that caused Lorenado to not deal damage to Unstoppable enemies.

• Hogger Level 20 No Control Fixed an issue that caused No Control to target enemies that are not visible.

• Jaina Base Frostbolt [Q] Fixed an issue that caused Frostbolt's range indicator and actual range to not match.

• Fixed an issue that caused Frostbolt cast by Ultimate Evolution clones of Jaina to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Blizzard [W] Fixed an issue that caused Blizzard used by Ultimate Evolution clones of Jaina to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Cone of Cold [E] Fixed an issue that caused Cone of Cold cast by Ultimate Evolution clones of Jaina to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Level 10 Summon Water Elemental Water Elemental's Basic Attacks damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Level 20 Wintermute Fixed an issue that caused Water Elemental's Wintermute effects to deal more damage than intended to Chilled targets.

• Wintermute's Blizzard damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Wintermute's Cone of Cold damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Wintermute's Cone of Cold now initiates its Cone of Cold cast at the same time Jaina initiates her cast and will be interrupted if it or Jaina is interrupted.

• Wintermute's Frostbolt damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Wintermute's Frostbolt now initiates its Frostbolt cast at the same time Jaina initiates her cast and will be interrupted if it or Jaina is interrupted.

• Kerrigan Level 10 Summon Ultralisk Fixed an issue that caused Kerrigan's Ultralisk to not have its damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Leoric Level 16 Royal Focus Now displays the remaining duration around Skeletal Swing's button.

• Malfurion Level 1 Vengeful Roots Fixed an issue that caused Malfurion's Treant to not have its damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Treant's damage will now display as Vengeful Roots in the Death Recap.

• Medivh Level 4 Raven Familiar Fixed an issue that caused Medivh's Raven Familiar created by Ultimate Evolution clones of Medivh to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Level 20 Guardian of Tirisfal Fixed an issue that caused targets near the edge of Arcane Rift's range with Guardian of Tirisfal to not be hit.

• Nazeebo Base Voodoo Ritual [Trait] Quest progress indicators will now show around the killed enemy Minion.

• Quest progress will now be gained in instances where a second Nazeebo damages the target and the target dies within 6 seconds of the first Nazeebo applying Voodoo Ritual.

• Fixed an issue that caused stacks of Voodoo Ritual gained prior to selecting Thing of the Deep to not be granted to Thing of the Deep.

• Fixed an issue that caused Vodoo Ritual's tooltip to display the incorrrect total damage value.

• Fixed an issue that caused Vile Infection's tooltip to display the incorrrect total damage value.

• Level 1 Thing of the Deep No longer causes Voodoo Ritual to display two Quest indicators.

• Level 4 Blood Ritual Fixed an issue that caused Blood Ritual to not grant Health or Mana when the target affected by Voodoo Ritual timed out due to their Health passively being reduced.

• Nova Level 20 Fast Reload Fixed an issue that caused Fast Reload to trigger when a Triple Tap target dies before it hits them.

• Probius Base Photon Cannon [E] Fixed an issue that caused Probius's Photon Cannons to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Level 1 Gathering Minerals Now also empowers any Photon Cannon already on the battlefield upon Quest completion.

• Tychus Base Overkill [Q] Fixed an issue that caused Overkill to reveal unintended areas.

• Xul Base Raise Skeleton [Trait] Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Warriors to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Level 10 Skeletal Mages Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Mages to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Mages to not apply their Slow in an aura while Blinded or against Evading Heroes.

• Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Mages to not apply their Slow with their attacks against Heroes with Heroic Attack only Evasion effects.

• Level 16 Weaken Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Warriors to not apply Weaken's damage reduction while Xul is Blinded or against Heroes with Heroic Attack only Evasion effects.

• Yrel Base Avenging Wrath [E] Fixed an issue that caused Yrel's Avenging Wrath to be interrupted by Roots while being channeled.

• Zagara Base Infested Drop [E] Fixed an issue that caused Roaches created by Ultimate Evolution clones of Zagara to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

title: Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes - May 11, 2026
description:
We’ve just released a patch to the live servers in order to apply some balance and bug fixes.

Quick Navigation:

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

Map Updates

• Haunted Mines Skull scaling increased from 5% to 7%.

• Golem scaling before 5 minutes decreased.

• Golem scaling later in the game significantly increased.

Balance Update

Heroes

Arthas

Base

• Base Stats Health increased from 2625 to 2750.

• Death Coil [Q] Healing increased from 262 to 275.

• Frostmourne Hungers [D] Attack damage per quest stack reduced from 1 to 0.75.

• Damage bonus on charged attacks increased from 1 to 3.

Talents

• Level 1 Frost Presence Upon unlocking the line Damage, targets can now be hit by both the line AND the final area.

• Death Coil Slow benefit duration increased from .75 seconds to 1.25 seconds.

• Level 7 Icebound Fortitude Now removes Slows and Roots upon activation.

• Level 20 Path of Frost Now increases minimum Movement Speed to 140%, rather than providing +40% Movement Speed.

Chen

Base

• Flying Kick [Q] Damage increased from 120 to 130.

• Fortifying Brew [D] Delay before being able to interrupt decreased slightly.

• Shields provided per tick increased from 90 to 95.

Talents

• Level 1 Accumulating Flame Initial hit now provides a quest stack.

• Stack requirements increased from 20/75 to 25/80.

Deathwing

Base

• Now also applies to Tyrande upon activation.

• Level 20 Commander of Sentinels NEW: Sentinel now has an additional charge.

Bug Fixes

Heroes

• Alarak Level 10 Deadly Charge Fixed an issue that caused Alarak's Deadly Charge to not be activated by clicking the left mouse button if it occupies the Trait slot.

• Ana Base Aim Down Sights [D] Can now be toggled while affected by a Silencing effect.

• Jaina Base Frostbolt [Q] Fixed an issue causing Jaina's Frostbolt to not have its model updated by Dreadlord Jaina or Lunar Jaina.

• Orphea Level 4 Allegrissimo Fixed an issue that could cause Allegrissimo's cooldown reduction to not be granted when hitting a Hero at Shadow Waltz' end.

• Sylvanas Base Possession [1] Fixed Possession not showing in the Quick Cast menu settings.

• Fixed Possession not being correctly affected by cooldown reduction affects granted by allies.

• Tychus Level 10 Commandeer Odin Fixed an issue that caused Tychus' Odin to not display a cooldown for its Thrusters Ability.
